reviews.text: Inspite of the long wait time and very simple looking practice, the vet is amazing! Hes very patient, intelligent and clearly cares. My cat has been unwell for some time and struggling to eat, within 8 of starting her new meds her appetite is back and she's eating almost normally
I recommend them for your pet; very friendly and good service.
Listened to me, answered my questions and gave firm advice. They were a good clinic to bring my puppy too.

Such an amazing staff and amazing vet! I took my cat here as a walk-in because I couldn't secure an appointment. I went in early enough and was in and out within an hour. The doctor attended to my needs and gave me the necessary medication. Everyone that works here is very nice and attentive. My new favorite place!
Get rid of the AI answering machine. It shouldn’t take me 8+ calls to get hung up on repeatedly.

Exceptional service Great customer service. Professional
and very knowledgeable

The best place to take your baby's omg they are all so kind  thank  you for all your help keep up the good work
Tre Renard
Monica D
Very reasonable. Caring doctors.

Mission Bend Animal Clinic is truly a blessing! A local veterinarian referred me to Dr. Chandra. I was quoted between $2000-$5000 for bladderstone removal for my dog at the other clinic. At MBAC, I paid under $2000. This included pre-, during, and post care, all of the prescriptions, and the specialized food for my pet. I love the itemized invoice and the fact that the veterinarians here explained the entire procedure to me and the aftercare. The staff was also kind and helpful. I can truly say it's not about the money but the pets!
The staff is friendly and the prices are affordable, only the waiting times are a little long
Very clean, friendly staff.

I am extremely disappointed with the way I was treated at this veterinary clinic. I arrived with my dog during an emergency, desperately needing immediate care, but they refused to see us because the doctor was about to leave.

This clinic’s posted business hours are from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and I arrived during those hours expecting emergency assistance. I have trusted this clinic with my dog for the past six years, but when we truly needed help, they turned us away.

Refusing to treat an animal in an emergency simply because the doctor was leaving shows a complete lack of compassion and humanity. After being a loyal client for so many years, I never expected to be treated this way.

I sincerely hope the clinic reconsiders how it handles emergency situations, because no pet owner should have to experience this when their beloved animal needs urgent medical attention.
I volunteer/foster with a rescue.  The receptionist ladies are kind and patient.  The doc has a lot of experience and wisdom.

I dropped off a kitten for a spay appointment for a rescue. The process was pretty straight forward. It's hard to turn into the parking lot and its a small/tight parking lot with plenty of blind spots so be very careful entering and exiting the parking lot.

Great vets. Very well run spot in mission bend. I bring all my pets here(5). It's affordable and all the girls helping around the office are so sweet! I love it here and absolutely put my trust in these vets.
1 of my very angry chihuahuas got a bad case of ear mites to the point where he got a hematoma on one of his ears. I took him in and ge ended up needing surgery on his ear, I'm happy to say that he is now recovering and doing great! Thank you so much for being the best vets I could ever ask for!!! 💗
They’ve been so amazing to my sweet little chihuahua for years! Great vets! I definitely recommend them!

⭐☆☆☆☆ (1 Star)

Extremely disappointing experience. The male customer service representative was incredibly rude, unprofessional, and repeatedly hung up the phone instead of addressing my concerns. As a customer, I expect to be treated with basic respect, but that was not the case. Communication was poor, and the lack of professionalism made an already frustrating situation even worse. I would not recommend this business based on the customer service I received. I hope management addresses these issues and provides additional training to their staff.

Always they make my service dog travel so we can flight safety!!!
Thank you doctor !

I’ll be honest, I don’t make it past the initial phone call with this vet clinic. I called in for my husky, who had gotten into it with another dog and has an issue with his eye. I explained that he was still using it, opening his eye lid, I could see no scratches, but it’s swollen and goopy.
The lady on the phone, obviously not the vet themselves, decided to tell me that they were going to most likely have to amputate!!!!! She didn’t ask further questions, ask for pictures, tell me to come in immediately, nothing.
I drove down to my previous vet to avoid coming here and it was worth the drive. My Husky is FINE and just needed antibiotics.
Completely unprofessional and honestly just out of pocket.
Imagine calling a shop saying that your check engine light is on and the first thing they say is “oh, well you’re most likely gonna need a new engine so just come on in and let us take it out”. Uhm, excuse me?
It makes it seem like answers are not looked for and that my dog wouldn’t be cared for at the level he deserves.
I’d call back to tell them to pound sand and stop doing this but I think this will be a little more lasting and heard.
To all the vet techs and the vet at the office, I’m sure you guys are great, but please look into furthering training with your receptionist.
Wild that I have an appointment and I’m still sitting waiting over an hour and a half later. What’s the point of an appointment if my time isn’t valued or even respected?

Excellent service, the doctors are super attentive to the animals, I loved it there. I take my cats and my dog ​​there all the time. I recommend this clinic; I have friends who drive from very far away just to take their pets there.

We brought our pup in this weekend for a severe ear infection and allergies, and it turned into a long and stressful visit. The team took great care of her every step of the way. I especially want to recognize Hector. His kindness, patience, and genuine compassion truly stood out. He went above and beyond to make both me and my dog feel more comfortable during a very overwhelming situation, and his level of care did not go unnoticed.  You can tell he truly cares about what he does, and it made all the difference for us. I’m so grateful for him he turned a difficult day into a much more positive experience. Thank you as well to the veterinarian for their excellent care and professionalism we felt confident our baby was in good hands.

I cannot thank the team here enough for saving the lives of my moms two cats.  My mother got to the clinic and they acted quickly to stabilize our cats.  The veterinarians here are so knowledgeable and the staff is amazing.  I’ve always had great experiences here and have always been treated with respect.

I highly recommend this vet clinic.   Their prices are affordable and they really care about you and your pets.

Thank you again for saving our Chiquis and Moo Moo!

I had a very bad experience at this veterinary clinic.

After checking in, I waited about 1 hour and 30 minutes while 4 other people were seen before me. The receptionist said the doctor does not speak Spanish, and it was clear I was left for last because I do not speak English.

This is unacceptable. Everyone deserves respect and fair treatment regardless of the language they speak.

I felt discriminated against and very disappointed with the service. I do not recommend this place, especially for Spanish-speaking customers.

I am forever grateful to everyone here at the clinic! I have been taking my boys here to the clinic for a while, they are always well taken care of, and they even saved my boy Loki when he had bladder stones and was in critical condition!
Good.

I’ve been taking my dog here for years! They’re affordable! The doctors are so nice and gentle with my 5lb chihuahua. My chihuahua has multiple issues and they’ve done an amazing job at helping me maintain her conditions. I definitely recommend them!
I always bring my pets here!
Excellent service, everything was great, thank you.

I highly recommend Misión Bend Animal Clinic! They accept walk-ins, but appointments are best since they can get busy.
Their prices are very fair, and they’ve never pushed unnecessary tests or medications. My dog is a senior with compensated heart failure, and I trust their vets completely—they’re knowledgeable, honest, and truly focus on your pet’s wellbeing. The entire staff is friendly and genuinely caring.
If you want high-quality, trustworthy care without overpaying, this is the clinic to choose!

Excellent care and staff. My cat suddenly got very sick. As soon they opened,  I called to get him a appointment. They were booked for the day but told me to bring him as a walk-in. I did and the Vet saw him right away and gave the medicines he needed. I'm grateful to the staff and the vet that took excellent care of my cat. I highly recommend the clinic 100%.

HORRIBLE customer service and a complete lack of adequate staffing. There is absolutely no reason a client should have to micromanage the front desk. They took over four business days just to approve a Chewy order. They also discriminated against my German Shepherd, who is a sweetheart and has never shown any signs of aggression. Please read the other reviews to see how they do NOT properly care for pets after surgery. Shame on Mission Bend Animal Clinic. Upper management needs to step in and do something—oh wait, the doctor is a penny-pincher who refuses to hire adequate staff. This place is a complete joke.

DO NOT bring your pet here. The staffs are extremely rude and they failed to provide clear pricing information. They added charges that exceed the initially stated amount and gave absurd explanations for the additional fees, recommending unnecessary treatments and medication. Both the nurses and the doctor act disgusted with my pet. My pet’s wound did not heal after 14 days. They keep asking to redo the stitches because it was poorly done the previous two times. Now I have to take my pet to another clinic to close the surgery wound from 14 days ago. This animal clinic should be shut down.

Decent pricing and some of the staff are friendly some standoffish but overall a decent experience.  Doctor is very thorough and knowledgeable. Parking is minimal so would suggest an early morning appointment.
Great service and the staff was super friendly and answered all of our questions. Only reason it didn't get 5 stars was do to the parking.
I wish we found this place sooner. Dr Chandra is so kind and knowledgeable, very professional and also compassionate. Also the prices are reasonable unlike many other places
Absolutely fantastic! Excellent service, excellent price! Wow! Free time eating, excellent staff!

Dr. Chandra has been caring for our dogs since COVID. He has been a true blessing, demonstrating true love for his patients. He has helped us with our older dogs, seeing they are happy and healthy through their golden years. We thought there was nothing that could be done, and he prescribed medication that  brings them back from what seems the brink of death.
Their care for animals results in what some perceive as poor customer service. The reality is that they will prioritize emergencies over routine service. We have seen much longer wait times at veterinarians throughout the area, and the loving care we receive from Dr Chandra makes the wait worthwhile.
The parking lot is tiny, compared with their service base. If possible, I park on Corona Del Mar (the street around the corner) and walk the short distance to the clinic. I have been fortunate when Blue (80+ lb husky) and Milo (100lb German Shepherd) were unable to walk, that we could park in their lot.

I was very impressed with this Clinic.  The girls in the front are super nice and the Doctors were great.  The prices were reasonable  & the Doctors were very compassionate when they treated my cats.  I was referred to this Clinic by ND. I will bring my pets here from now on. Thank you for caring so much for all the animals that are treated at your Clinic. Awesome place !
Excellent service
Very friendly staff. Definitely going back.
This place deserves all the stars. Dr Padidem always takes good care of my blue heelers. I no longer live in the area but the drive is worth it.
Staff was nice and the veterinarian was thorough and kind. They were good at giving my cat her steroid shot: quick and easy! Also very affordable. Will definitely be coming back.
An excellent place, the service is very professional.

Hector, was an amazing person he helped me out to the extreme after I was rejected from the vet due to me walking in after 3pm when was told I could walk in and was not giving an specific time when to NOT walk in. I spoke to a non professional receptionist who did not give me the correct information over the phone much less her name when she answered the phone. BUT overall Hector helped me out and didn't let me leave unsatisfied with his help. Thank you again Hector for understanding me on my end and going above and beyond for what you do.

The love you have for the animals is amazing!
My family has been bringing our dogs here since 1982. Doctors have changed, but still the same great care and service.
Highly recommend this place nice staff and doctor

Today was my first time with my puppy and I felt very comfortable as my puppy was very well cared for and attended to by the staff. I hope to stay here forever. The prices were very much in line with my budget.

This was our first time coming to this Vet. I had a senior dog with a large growth on his back leg. Because of all his other issues. Euthanasia was the best choice. Most vets wouldn't do it because he was a fear biter. This Vet had no problem booking us an appointment. We waited in the car until they had a room ready, they brought us in the side door and right to a room. The vet tech and the vet both treated us like we had been clients for yrs. They were very compassionate and explained everything before they did anything. They were amazing and I can't say enough good about them. Having to euthanasia one of your animals is never easy. They did such a phenomenal job that I will be bringing in my other pets to be seen by them.
The veterinarians and assistants are very kind. Thank you!

LOUSY parking lot very awful…. I arrive vet they say 2 hours. That appointment set up why wait wait 2 hours.  Please not call appointment nothing. I will never go back STUPID.  You all need other vet let them learn lesson!

I bring all my dogs here and always had a good experience with the vet and the techs.  They are all very lovely people, from reception, all the way to the veterinarian.

Thank you for helping me better care for my fur babies!
Miss Melissa answered my call, she explained everything patiently and kindly, and I successfully made my appointment.

First time visiting Mission Bend Animal Clinic, the wait time was excessive, but the staff was very friendly and helpful. The parking lot is small and not many are available to park. I saw clients parking across in the car wash.

This girl at the front desk with glasses is HORRIBLE.!!
She does not acknowledge anyone, ignores an you will wait for hours just for an appointment or exam!
She did not even mention anything your basically just sitting there waiting until you continue to ask questions with no response. Horrible customer/client service and i’d avoid this place read their google reviews as well. Def not coming back .
The staff was very friendly and it was very affordable. I’m kinda new to this area but tell you what I found me a new veterinarian.

This vet clinic has been a true blessing for me and my fur baby. They’re incredibly loving, attentive, and genuinely care about the well-being of the animals they treat. On top of that, their prices are very affordable, which has been a huge help. I’ve received great care and support here, and I’m so grateful for everything they’ve done for us. Highly recommend!
Very good clinic, the service is excellent and the prices are good. I recommend it 100%. The doctor and nurse are super friendly.

My dog was very sick. We had tried 2 weeks of antibiotics and steroids but he wasnt getting better, in fact he was worse. He had lost 4lbs in those 2 weeks and was having difficulty breathing. Hector got us in last minute on a Saturday and was so compassionate and genuinely concerned about our Buster. He went above and beyond to comfort not only Buster but myself and my grandson.  Hector answered my questions honestly and did not try to suggest procedures that were not necessary, in fact I had asked if Buster needed x-rays and he told me in his opinion no but that would be up to the doctor. I was so emotional as we have had Buster 9 years and he is family, Hector continued to say comforting words and staying so positive throughout our visit. Right now we are still waiting on test results but Hector sure made out visit a little easier. THANK YOU HECTOR the world needs more people like you😊
Awesome place to take your 4-legged babies, they are so caring and gentle with my Buddy.

I wish I could give NEGATIVE STARS.
It is sad to know that the staff only care about getting their money no care for the animals at all! Dog was taken to them for back legs giving out, did bloodwork,xrays and just said “heres some NSAIDs   “ never cared to check where the source of his infection that showed in the blood work came from .. a VETERINARY ASSISTANT (me) (I don’t even work there!!)was the one that after 3 days had to tell them to check his ears as the dog was SURELY showing signs of SEVERE middle ear infection. Something that could of been fixed but no them just wanting to euthanize the dog and not give any help , the dog unfortunately passed due to the infection getting so bad it attacked his brain . HORRIBLE SERVICE
Amazing place for your fur baby!
Very kind

Hector and Dr. Chandra Padiddem were WONDERFUL!  They listened to my concerns about my dog and were so attentive and compassionate.  Although we have our regular vet that we go to, I wil, however, be changing my pet's to now go to Mission Bend Animal Clinic.  These people are AMAZING and reasonably priced.  I can't say enough about the great service we received.  Even the front desk girl (whom I unfortunately didn't get her name) was super nice as well.  They totally ROCK!  Keep up the good work!

Gave me back my babygirl Raven from her spay appointment sitting In her own pee :(
For $300 they could’ve put a puppy pad at least.
Should’ve read the reviews before hand.
Doctors are calm, thorough, and empathetic. Price conscious
Excellent staff. They really care about your pet.
Best clinic in town! Doc was very informative!

Gosh. Where do I start? This place was truly a blessing. Their prices were extremely affordable. Especially for X-Rays. I shopped around for a week and no place came close to their prices. I drove all the way from Magnolia, and would do it again, and again. The staff were friendly. The Vet was so knowledgeable and such a sweet soul. They treated us, and my cat with the outmost care. Very little wait time.  If you’re looking for an affordable, yet extreme knowledgeable and loving care. Look no further. You have found the place. Thank you again.

Our dog and cat are treated at Mission Bend Animal Clinic. The team is always so amazing and the dr truly cares for our fur babies. The pricing is reasonable for all services. We would never go anywhere else
Excellent service, very friendly and professional
Very nice Animal Clinic! Vet and Staff are very friendly and nice to my pets.
My for the care of my older dog

On Monday, I brought my pregnant and vulnerable dog to this clinic for a spay procedure. She’s a gentle, loving dog, and I trusted them to provide her with proper care during such a sensitive time. However, when I picked her up, I was heartbroken to see her soaking wet, shivering, and clearly miserable. Her entire body—from her face to her legs and stomach—was wet with fluids, saliva, and what seemed like urine.

It was evident that she was neglected during her recovery. Instead of ensuring she was dry, warm, and comfortable after surgery, she was left in a state that only added to her distress. She was crying and appeared absolutely miserable. For the hundreds of dollars I paid for this procedure, I expected basic care and compassion for my dog—not to pick her up freezing cold and soaking wet.

At the very least, the clinic should have provided her with a towel, blanket, or something to dry her off and keep her warm. This level of neglect is unacceptable, and I am extremely disappointed. I will never bring any animal to this clinic again and cannot recommend them to others.
Inexpensive place to take your fur babies. The veterinarians here are wonderful, patient, educated, empathetic and dedicated. Highly highly recommend Mission Bend Animal Clinic.
Great place. Only suggestion to management is that they have to keep clinic more cleaner.

Standard of this place has come down

Won’t recommend to anyone

Receptionist are most useless people on earth

This place used to be great but the wait time is disappointing. I have a dog with high anxiety so I keep him in  the car while waiting for his appointment. I had to cancel the last 4 appointments due to the wait time. In the last year, I’ve never been able to be seen within 30min of the appointment. It’s hard to have a dog with anxiety waiting over an hour for the appointment and then another 30min-45min sitting in a room. Literally right now I’m sitting on the phone on hold for 15min just to get an appointment and no one has came back to the line. I’m going to just get my baby a new vet.

Been bringing my dogs here since 2020, and I will never return. Both of my dogs have always been healthy, only having to come in for yearly shots and check ups and the occasional visit for some hot spot ointment or teeth cleanings. I’ve always felt like it’s bare minimum effort put in- never over the top- but for our needs it was no big deal. So if you have healthy dogs that don’t need actual care- this place is fine. In September my 6 year old dog started vomitting randomly and I knew something was wrong. I took her in & they sent me home with nausea meds. 3 weeks later I felt like she was worsening so I took her back and they gave me different meds. 3 weeks after that I took her back again because she was physically deteriorating and I was getting scared. Again- dismissed and told to give the meds more time. Finally 3 weeks later I took her to a completely different vet because I was so frustrated and I just knew something was wrong. Turns out she had rapidly growing and spreading masses in her abdomen and her lab values were beyond critical. She soon after had to be put down. I wish MBAC would’ve run some test… done some imaging… literally anything more than just giving us a bandaid for her symptoms. Needless to say I’m finding another vet for my other dog because my trust here is nonexistent.
